name: os-world-modified
description: os-world-modified is a curated/modified dataset derived from open-source software artifacts intended to evaluate models on code understanding and generation in the open-source context. It includes examples that test repository-level reasoning, code synthesis, and metadata classification, enabling benchmarking of models on realistic OSS code tasks. The modified variant adapts or filters the original collection for reproducibility and targeted evaluation.
reputation: Maintained within the open-source benchmarking community; moderately used by researchers focused on code-model evaluation but not yet broadly adopted.
